status: frozen before audio-model review and candidate inference
authorization: User explicitly requested audio-capable model/tool review with model-reviewed references separate from human-verified ones.
reviewer: SenseVoiceSmall int8 2024-07-17, sherpa-onnx1.13.6, CPU8threads; custom checkpoint terms recorded separately
input_rule: Only frozen mono16k waveform and English language flag; no text prompt, publisher draft, grammar/hotword list or Whisper predictions passed to recognizer.
reference_policy: Freeze exact blind-review output before candidates. Preserve raw recognition; no post-hoc reference cleanup from Whisper or silent publisher correction. Model-reviewed means provisional machine reference, not human truth. Publisher overlap/lineage is separate.
comparison: Same three pinned faster-whisper scales/settings as prior protocol; fresh process worker CLI; available manual caption tracks compared to model reference with shared-publisher provenance visible. WER/CER are agreement with machine reference, not calibrated accuracy.
timing: SenseVoice emits token time points; no acoustic word interval or human-boundary truth. Report diagnostic start-time disagreement only on exactly matched lexical spans; no timing-accuracy/forced-alignment win claim.
qualitative_only: Spoken self-correction preservation, without forced ideal command rewrite.
Source/destination explanation: publisher cues overlap clip edges; do not assume complete referent speech is within clip.
music_policy: User-designated music-only tracks excluded from speech-reference scoring; synthetic silence/tones remain separate controls.
stop_rule: One blind reviewer pass, freeze, one pass per eligible candidate; failures/disagreements remain explicit. No search/tuning on this corpus.
resource_policy: Separate reviewer download/load/inference and candidate costs; no serving/default integration.
